     Data points for FIGURE 1

Charged hadron invariant yield versus transverse momentum 
for 4 bins in centrality.

Centrality notation: 100%=Most peripheral, 0%=Most central

Units: pT in Gev/c, yield&err are invariant yield
                    (2pi*pT)^{-1} d2N/(deta dpT) (GeV/c)^{-2} 

Systematic errors are 90% CL.
